row.title: Adverse reactions the MAH must collect and report include lack of efficacy, misuse, overdose, medication errors and occupational exposure
row.statement: The adverse reactions that the MAH, through the local QPPV system, must collect, evaluate and submit to the Authority include any noxious and unintended response to a product, including lack of efficacy, at any dose, arising from use within or outside the terms of the marketing authorisation (including overdose, off-label use, misuse, abuse and medication errors) or from occupational exposure; adverse reaction and adverse event are used interchangeably.
